single_probability_endpoint.name: atlas_per_bit_position_kt_correctness_v1
single_probability_endpoint.state: For each D/G/S/R/N arm and byte bit position, isolated uint64 correct and wrong counts initialized logically by the KT half-count law; no saturation or rescale is permitted and overflow is fatal.
single_probability_endpoint.pretruth_probability: r=floor(((2*correct+1)*65536)/(2*(correct+wrong+1))), clamped to [1,65535]; assign r to the donor bit and 65536-r to its complement.
single_probability_endpoint.update: After the true bit is decoded, increment only the selected arm and bit-position correct or wrong uint64 count; the same exact arithmetic and state serialization are used by Atlas and native code.
single_probability_endpoint.identity: The Atlas shadow and native codec must use byte-identical integer probabilities and calibration-state digests on the same truth prefix.
single_probability_endpoint.forbidden: No direct distribution, learned endpoint, alternate smoothing, per-route calibration, or post-Atlas endpoint selection exists in v2.
